links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot responses to ankylosing spondylitis queries (GFOG, FRES, SMOG)
links.effect: Readability levels of chatbot answers were above the 6th grade level, with statistically significant differences between chatbots (p < 0.001).
links.quote: It was found that the readability levels of the answers produced by AI-based chatbots were above the 6th grade level and showed a statistically significant difference (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient-facing answers relative to recommended level
links.effect: Answers exceeded the recommended readability level (above 6th grade) across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
links.quote: It has been found that the answers given by AI chatbots to AS-related questions exceed the recommended readability level and the reliability and quality assessment raises concerns due to some low scores.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots answering frequent patient search queries about ankylosing spondylitis for readability, quality, and reliability, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
